suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(pheatmap)
  library(RColorBrewer)
})
raw <- read.csv("inputs/heatmap-values-555555555555.csv", header = FALSE, check.names = FALSE)
groups <- as.character(raw[1, -1])
samples <- as.character(raw[2, -1])
genes <- as.character(raw[[1]])[-(1:2)]
mat <- as.matrix(raw[-(1:2), -1])
storage.mode(mat) <- "numeric"
rownames(mat) <- genes
colnames(mat) <- samples
annotation_col <- data.frame(Group = factor(groups, levels = c("group1", "group2")), row.names = samples)
group_colors <- list(Group = c(group1 = "#4C9F70", group2 = "#C0392B"))
max_abs <- max(abs(mat), na.rm = TRUE)
breaks <- seq(-max_abs, max_abs, length.out = 101)
pal <- colorRampPalette(rev(brewer.pal(11, "RdBu")))(100)
pheatmap(mat, scale = "row", color = pal, breaks = breaks,
  cluster_cols = FALSE, cluster_rows = TRUE,
  annotation_col = annotation_col, annotation_colors = group_colors,
  show_rownames = TRUE, show_colnames = TRUE, fontsize = 9,
  fontsize_row = 9, fontsize_col = 9, angle_col = 45, cutree_rows = 2,
  border_color = "white", legend = TRUE,
  legend_breaks = c(-max_abs, 0, max_abs), legend_labels = c("low", "0", "high"),
  main = "Heatmap of 20 Genes × 26 Samples (R · pheatmap)",
  filename = "heatmap_r.png", width = 10, height = 8, dpi = 200)
cat("Saved heatmap_r.png\n")

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
from matplotlib.colors import LinearSegmentedColormap
raw = pd.read_csv("inputs/heatmap-values-555555555555.csv", header=None)
groups = raw.iloc[0, 1:].values
samples = raw.iloc[1, 1:].values
genes = raw.iloc[2:, 0].values
data = raw.iloc[2:, 1:].astype(float).values
df = pd.DataFrame(data, index=genes, columns=samples)
group_labels = pd.Series(groups, index=df.columns, name="Group")
group_palette = {"group1": "#4C9F70", "group2": "#C0392B"}
group_colors = group_labels.map(group_palette)
cmap = LinearSegmentedColormap.from_list("blue_white_red", ["#3B4CC0", "#F7F7F7", "#B40426"])
vmax = np.nanmax(np.abs(df.values))
vmin = -vmax
g = sns.clustermap(df, cmap=cmap, vmin=vmin, vmax=vmax, center=0,
    col_cluster=False, row_cluster=True, figsize=(11, 9), linewidths=0.4,
    linecolor="white", cbar_kws={"label": "Expression (z-score)"},
    col_colors=group_colors, dendrogram_ratio=(0.12, 0.18), colors_ratio=0.025)
g.ax_heatmap.set_xlabel("Sample")
g.ax_heatmap.set_ylabel("Gene")
g.ax_heatmap.set_xticklabels(g.ax_heatmap.get_xticklabels(), rotation=70, ha="right", fontsize=9)
g.ax_heatmap.set_yticklabels(g.ax_heatmap.get_yticklabels(), rotation=0, fontsize=9)
g.ax_heatmap.set_title("Heatmap of 20 Genes × 26 Samples (Python · seaborn)", pad=18)
from matplotlib.patches import Patch
legend_handles = [Patch(facecolor=group_palette["group1"], label="group1"), Patch(facecolor=group_palette["group2"], label="group2")]
g.ax_heatmap.legend(handles=legend_handles, title="Group", loc="upper left", bbox_to_anchor=(1.18, 1.0), frameon=False)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig("heatmap_python.png", dpi=200, bbox_inches="tight")
print("Saved heatmap_python.png")
print("Shape:", df.shape)
print("Group counts:", dict(zip(*np.unique(groups, return_counts=True))))
